{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA orders with '999999.99'
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Now, clean all revenue values: remove commas and cast to float
# Even though QA orders are gone, some real revenue values still have commas
# Use string replace to remove commas
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify
print(f"First 5 revenue values after cleaning:")
print(df_clean['revenue'].head(5))

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"\nStatus distribution:")
print(df_clean['status'].value_counts())"}
